# Parabolic SAR

*Parabolic stop and reverse: trailing dots that flip with the trend.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** on the price pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Parabolic SAR** under **Trend**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start | float | `0.02` |
| Increment | float | `0.02` |
| Max value | float | `0.2` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/psar.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Parabolic SAR", shortTitle: "SAR", overlay: true });
const start = input.float("Start", 0.02, { min: 0, step: 0.01 });
const increment = input.float("Increment", 0.02, { min: 0, step: 0.01 });
const maximum = input.float("Max value", 0.2, { min: 0, step: 0.01 });
plot(ta.sar(start, increment, maximum), { title: "ParabolicSAR", style: "cross", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
